meta: Crooks can clone a grandchild's voice from a few seconds of video and call grandparents asking for money. Two ways to protect the family: a family password, and calling back.

muc.title: Faking a grandchild's voice
muc.text: Scammers can now use AI to fake a grandchild's voice and call grandparents asking for money urgently.

muc.title: A few seconds of voice is enough
muc.text: Just a few seconds of voice taken from a video posted online is enough for AI to copy a voice that sounds very real.

muc.title: Set a family password
muc.text: Pick a family password phrase together, and if a call asks for money urgently but can't say the phrase, hang up.

muc.title: Hang up and call back
muc.text: Then call back the grandchild's usual number yourself, because scammers can't answer the family member's real phone.

muc.title: Set the password today
muc.text: Call your grandparents today, choose an easy-to-remember password phrase together, and agree to send money only after calling back.
